messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: symmetry-forced configuration from finite reflection or rotation groups

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal symmetry-forced configuration of 13 points in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area is a D4-symmetric arrangement consisting of the square's center, four points on the main diagonals at coordinates (t,t), (1-t,1-t), (1-t,t), (t,1-t), and four points on the midlines at (1/2,u), (1/2,1-u), (u,1/2), (1-u,1/2), with t and u chosen to equalize the smallest triangle areas across all symmetry-distinct triples. Setting t ≈ 0.083 and u ≈ 0.267 yields a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.0058, which is conjectured to be maximal among all 13-point configurations whose symmetry group is a nontrivial subgroup of the square's reflection group."}
